source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 933 adds outputClosureType beside outputClosure in the noscript proxy interface and callback typedef. The proxy reconstructs a MimeClosure and sends both members to each output call; RemoveMimeCallback resets the callback and wrapper together. The receiving callback rejects an unexpected tag before casting. Preserve this pair across interface declarations, setters and invocations. The integer-to-enum cast itself does not validate arbitrary enum values.
title: Carry the MIME tag and pointer together across the OpenPGP callback boundary
